description: This Java class provides a utility with a main method for decrypting database passwords from their Base64-encoded encrypted form using a master password. It is used as a command-line tool to perform password decryption within the application infrastructure.

classes.name: DatabasePasswordDecryptor
classes.description: A utility class with a main method enabling command-line decryption of database passwords using a specified master password.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line password decryption, takes master password and base64 encrypted password as arguments, outputs the decrypted password.
